name: 11374 · Rego Park, NY
findings: ZIP 11374 (Rego Park) has 91 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11374 (Rego Park) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
89% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11374 (Rego Park) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 84% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
